d:
Jharkhand men peyjal ki shuddhata janchne vali sarkari vyavastha par tala lag gaya hai. rajy ke peyjal evan svachchhata vibhag ke adhin sanchalit sabhi 31 sarkari vatar testing laib 3 navanbar se band hain. aise men sabse bara saval hai ki aakhir jharkhand ke log jo pani pi rahe hain, uski gunvatta ki janch kaun karega?
In laib ke band hone se salana 2.23 lakh se adhik pani ke namunon ki janch prabhavit ho sakti hai. jal jivan mishan, gramin jalapurti yojnaon, kanke, hatiya aur ruka daim samet kaee pramukh jalashyon ke pani ki niymit janch bhi prabhavit huee hai.
